title: Annual risk assessment (2026), approved by the Authorizing Official Aubrel Ashbyfield

rows.threat: credential phishing leading to access to the CUI project enclave
rows.treatment: MFA for all users and admins, awareness training, Defender for Office 365

rows.threat: compromise of on-premises AD or the Entra Connect sync server vm-s2-sync-01 spreading to synchronised cloud accounts
rows.treatment: tiered AD administration, cloud-only admin and break-glass accounts, sync server hardening and monitoring

rows.threat: CUI leaking from personal Android phones (backup and Save As still allowed by app protection)
rows.treatment: tighten app protection: block backup, Save As and transfer to unmanaged apps (planned)

rows.threat: misuse or compromise of a managed IT provider technician account
rows.treatment: cloud-only contractor accounts, MFA, attended remote sessions, prompt offboarding

rows.threat: insider exfiltration of prime design models
rows.treatment: DLP policies, CUI label encryption, insider threat training

rows.threat: ransomware on an engineering laptop or CAD workstation
rows.treatment: Defender for Endpoint, Intune compliance, OneDrive and SharePoint versioning

rows.threat: unauthorised entry to the project room
rows.treatment: badge access, visitor escort, quarterly access review

rows.threat: delayed account disablement for departing contractors
rows.treatment: leaver workflow on provider notice; weekly contractor reconciliation by the ISSO
